init.title: Možnosti Glovo
init.description: Leave the refresh token empty to keep the current one. LIVE ORDERING IS ADMIN-ONLY. Preparation and paid checkout have separate default-off switches and acknowledgements; paid checkout requires preparation consent. Only the exact fresh server quote and provider-selected saved card can be submitted once. There is no retry, completion, cancellation, or payment mutation. Ambiguous outcomes block ordering for manual Glovo reconciliation; a learned checkout ID permits one explicit status GET with no polling. The full saved address is shown only ephemerally to the administrator and is not persisted in recovery data. Re-authentication resets all controls.

data.allow_ordering: Enable live ordering preparation (may change server basket/template)
data.ordering_acknowledged: I understand preparation can change remote state and ambiguous outcomes are never retried
data.allow_live_checkout: Enable one guarded live paid checkout submission
data.live_checkout_acknowledged: I authorize a single exact saved-card submission and will manually reconcile any uncertainty without retry

error.ordering_ack_required: Explicitly acknowledge the live-ordering and no-retry safety warning before enabling.
error.live_checkout_ack_required: Explicitly acknowledge the separate live paid-checkout warning before enabling.
